arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/ledger.rs'

grep -n "tcount" src/ledger.rs; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rust/lib /opt/rust/bin/rustc --edition=2021 --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -C opt-level=2 --crate-name rust_unit_merge --crate-type rlib src/lib.rs -o /tmp/test.rlib 2>&1 | grep -c "ledger.rs"; rm -f /tmp/test.rlib; cd /workspace && TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp sh submission/build.sh && cd dev && python3 difftest.py 400 0 2>&1|tail -1 && cd /workspace && python3 dev/mini_check.py && python3 dev/topocheck.py|tail -1 && python3 dev/pinsanity.py|tail -1
